tools.name: ograf_get_capabilities
tools.title: Get OGraf authoring capabilities
tools.description: Discover element/easing/semantic/design/loop/binding contracts by section. Include editor before browser work: connected, responsive and certificationReady are distinct.

tools.name: ograf_list_sessions
tools.title: List OGraf authoring sessions
tools.description: Lists open authoring sessions and their current revisions.

tools.name: ograf_get_changes
tools.title: Get OGraf revision changes
tools.description: Read up to 100 retained revisions after sinceRevision, with source and affected-layer summaries.

tools.name: ograf_get_project
tools.title: Get editable OGraf project
tools.description: Read project and revision. Omit filters for full data; include sections and tracks=animated-only reduce output. Preserve IDs.

tools.name: ograf_inspect_scene
tools.title: Inspect OGraf scene
tools.description: Read layers, bindings, masks, Lottie warnings, path anchors, resolved pattern motion and lifecycle. Preserve IDs and revision.

tools.name: ograf_query_scene
tools.title: Query OGraf scene by semantic intent
tools.description: Find layer IDs by semantics, name, type, bindings, visibility or motion; includes frame geometry, masks and authoring links.

tools.name: ograf_get_timeline
tools.title: Get OGraf property timeline
tools.description: Read property tracks, lifecycle and local loops, optionally filtered by layerIds. Easing applies to the incoming segment.

tools.name: ograf_sample_tracks
tools.title: Sample resolved OGraf layer geometry
tools.description: Sample tracks, bounds, shared lighting and pattern rows without a browser. loopElapsedFrame is absolute on-air time.

tools.name: ograf_render_frame
tools.title: Render OGraf frame
tools.description: Renders a deterministic SVG snapshot for visual inspection without changing the project.

tools.name: ograf_capture
tools.title: Capture browser-rendered OGraf PNG
tools.description: Capture browser PNG of a composition frame or live viewport; requires a responsive editor. Default frame is first Step. Composition supports matte/dataOverrides; viewport ignores them. Returns a five-minute URL; inline PNG is opt-in. Does not certify export.

tools.name: ograf_render_strip
tools.title: Render OGraf PNG frame strip
tools.description: Capture up to 12 labelled browser frames; defaults to lifecycle/midpoints. maxDimension is per tile. Five-minute URL; inline PNG opt-in.

tools.name: ograf_apply_operations
tools.title: Apply, preview, or propose OGraf operations
tools.description: Revision-checked atomic operations. apply commits; dry-run validates without changing revision. includeReview adds advisory QA and a capture when available; capture failure does not undo the edit. preview renders a revision-neutral frame/strip in the responsive editor. propose requires sessionId=editor and title, and waits for explicit human Accept/Reject.

tools.name: ograf_validate_project
tools.title: Validate editable OGraf project
tools.description: Validate semantics; optionally measure browser text overflow with stress testValues and broadcast lint. detail=summary shows failures/counts. Does not certify artifacts.

tools.name: ograf_review_design
tools.title: Review OGraf design and motion
tools.description: Advisory layout/type/color/motion QA with layer IDs. includeStrip captures browser frames. Does not certify export.

tools.name: ograf_measure_text
tools.title: Measure OGraf text in the browser
tools.description: Browser text fit, lines and overflow at first Step by default. degenerate means failed fitting. Parent clipping may be intentional; font resolution is inferred.

tools.name: ograf_create_project
tools.title: Create OGraf project session
tools.description: Creates a new in-memory editable OGraf project session. Use sessionId=editor only for the live browser project.

tools.name: ograf_reset_project
tools.title: Reset an OGraf project session
tools.description: Reset an existing session in one undoable transaction; requires confirm=true and expectedRevision. keepDataFields copies main-composition fields, not layers or bindings.

tools.name: ograf_delete_session
tools.title: Delete temporary OGraf authoring session
tools.description: Delete one non-editor in-memory session and history with confirm=true. Saved files remain.

tools.name: ograf_open_project
tools.title: Open OGraf editable project
tools.description: Opens a .ogs file (or legacy .ogeproj source) inside the configured workspace into a new authoring session.

tools.name: ograf_import_asset
tools.title: Import a workspace asset into OGraf
tools.description: Atomically embed one workspace image/font/CSS/text resource (max 32 MiB). Returns asset:<id> for layer sources or field defaults. Paths cannot leave the workspace.

tools.name: ograf_import_svg_bundle
tools.title: Import a portable Photoshop SVG bundle
tools.description: Atomically import one workspace SVG with companion CSS/images/fonts. Embeds relative references and registers fonts. Paths cannot leave the workspace; limits are 32 MiB per file and 64 MiB total.

tools.name: ograf_undo
tools.title: Undo agent change
tools.description: Undoes the latest agent-authored transaction in a session.

tools.name: ograf_redo
tools.title: Redo agent change
tools.description: Redoes the latest agent-authored transaction in a session.

tools.name: ograf_certify_project
tools.title: Certify exact OGraf output artifacts
tools.description: Certify exact compiled project, manifest, package, module and realtime/non-realtime lifecycle in a responsive editor.

tools.name: ograf_save_project
tools.title: Certify and save editable OGraf project
tools.description: Certify exact output in a responsive editor, then save editable .ogs inside the workspace.

tools.name: ograf_export_package
tools.title: Certify and export OGraf package
tools.description: Certify exact output in a responsive editor, then write a playout .ograf.zip inside the workspace.
